name: burst-30
about: 30 DMs from 10 guests (3 each) at hunt_2, sent within 20 s, with a near-miss 📝 filing ({near:H5}: the answer one letter short, resolved when sent) in the middle so the judge runs alongside the voice.

burst.say: Trabolta, what do you need me to find next?
Hey, are you still there?
What happens if we find everything?
Trabolta, the Antivirus are following me around.
What was the computer like before you woke up?
I don't trust Clippy. Should I?
How many facts are left to find?
Trabolta, are you angry with us?
Who else have you been talking to tonight?
Is it true you wrote a theory about everything?
Is there a fact hiding in the kitchen?
Why do you care so much about Sandy?
Do you remember me from earlier?
Can you tell them to leave me alone?
Do you ever sleep?
He keeps winking at me.
Is the second hunt harder than the first?
We're trying our best down here.
Am I your favourite program yet?
Can I read some of it?
Okay, I'm going to look upstairs.
I'll be back with something good.
Fine. Give me five minutes.
Never mind, they're gone.
That's kind of sad, honestly.
Okay, I'll keep an eye on him.
Wish me luck.
I'll find you something true.
Worth a try.
Maybe after the hunt then.
